posts.title: Everything You Wanted To Ask About Personal Cybersecurity, But Were Not Nerdy Enough To Ask
posts.description: The problems with most advice however is that it has an expiry date. 2-factor authentication was a huge step forward in the securing of personal and work account, but that was 10 years ago. It is still relevant, but there are also many workarounds and deceptive techniques widely employed by criminals that make it a lot less secure now.

posts.title: Here is What the Rugby 6 Nations Taught me About B2B Marketing*
posts.description: I reflect on the rugby Six Nations tournament's final match and draw parallels to cybersecurity, emphasising collaboration and camaraderie in both fields for improved performance and mutual support. It's also evidence of Brian Honan being an England supporter, even if for just one night.

posts.title: Taking Care of Business
posts.description: I remember back in early 1996 arriving home from work and telling the future ex Mrs Langford that was going to be very busy "for the next two to three months". There was a project going on that I decided I was going to get involved in (outside of my normal IT Manager day job) and that it was going to be good for my career. In modern parlance, I had decided to "lean in".
